checks.detail: Exact pre-run protocol and evaluator hashes unchanged; source report is not overwritten by audit.

All 4,707 qualifying product IDs persisted before old 3,231-SKU eligibility mask. New study ignores old eligible mask; product-code/row-validity filters are fixed, not future-activity filters. Workbook SHA verified. Returns/cancellations excluded from positive-sales target and separately preserved; no new net-demand relabeling.

Missing SKU-date is zero recorded positive sales only within publisher-declared complete ledger. Whole-ledger zero dates are disclosed separately. Unknown dates supplied to engine remain null and block applicable forecasts.
Each fold recomputed on 4,707-item matrix using only pre-validation days; catalog hashes verified, no test inactivity exclusions.

Eight disjoint 28-day test windows, four disjoint 7-day origins each; validation precedes own test. Prior folds may become later history, as allowed in rolling evaluation. Original Oct–Dec period not scored.
Each reported winner and quantile window equals predeclared validation argmin, using candidate-order and shorter-window exact tie breaking. No test winner replacement.
Four SKU prefixes: every label after origin replaced by 1,234,567; all four recurrence states, all 14 point candidates, all three empirical quantile windows unchanged at and before origin.
280 independent point predictions across intermittent, zero-heavy and burst demand match vectorized evaluator.
Zero actual total returns null WAPE, never 0% accuracy; absolute error remains defined. All-zero tie chooses zero and 8-week window.
Exact equality of all aggregate/fold metrics, quantile diagnostics and 400-replicate paired intervals on a clean isolated output rerun; nondeterministic runtime/timestamp excluded.

Verified source arrays are SKU × fold; each replicate resamples one shared SKU index list and fold blocks, preserving each selected SKU trajectory across folds and all seven daily horizons. Only eight time blocks, one retailer: intervals remain descriptive.
Publication copy removes only executor path and renames the protocol projection; all metrics, original hashes and source identity remain unchanged.

limits: Audit does not make previously exposed data pristine.
Raw workbook bytes and profiled handling verified; audit does not independently reparse all 1,067,371 rows.
No actual stockout labels exist; no operational-warning accuracy audit possible.
